profile.headline: Lead Software Enginner
profile.summary:
Innovative software engineer with 12+ years of experience in the full stack software development lifecycle – from
concept through delivery of next-generation applications and customizable solutions. Expert in advanced development
methodologies, tools and processes contributing to the design and rollout of cutting-edge software applications. Known
for excellent troubleshooting skills – able to analyze code and engineer well-researched, cost-effective and responsive
solutions.
